agnes.description: Agnes AI image and video generation, with automatic retry on rate limits and transient failures.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Check the Agnes plugin: which endpoints are configured, where the API key came from, the available image and video models, and the retry policy. Start here if a generation call fails.

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Generate an image with Agnes AI. Returns the image inline so you can see it, and can also save it to disk. Rate limits and transient server errors are retried automatically, so a call that hits a quota usually still succeeds.

savePath.description: Where to write the image. Use an ABSOLUTE path: the plugin server runs with the home directory as its working directory, not your workspace.

tools.name: generate_video
tools.description: Generate a video with Agnes AI. Text-to-video, single-image keyframe, or start/end keyframes. Generation is polled until the task completes; transient failures are retried automatically.

images.description: Reference image URLs: one for a keyframe, two for start/end keyframes.

numFrames.description: Frame count, if the model accepts it.

frameRate.description: Frame rate, if the model accepts it.

savePath.description: Where to download the video. Use an ABSOLUTE path: the plugin server runs with the home directory as its working directory, not your workspace.
